report_title: Form 40-F Annual Report for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
notes: NO FY2025 REPORT EXISTS: MAG Silver was acquired by Pan American Silver on September 4, 2025 ($500 million cash + 60.2 million PAAS shares) and ceased to be a reporting issuer (Form 15-12G filed Sept 2025). All figures below are FY2024 from the 40-F filed 2025-03-24 (EDGAR accession 0001171843-25-001642). Juanicipio is operated by Fresnillo plc (56%); MAG held a 44% non-operating JV interest. Production figures: 100%-basis silver production 18.6 Moz and equivalent silver production 26.8 Moz; 44%-attributable silver production 8.184 Moz and equivalent silver production 11.792 Moz. Cash costs and AISC are reported on a 100% basis only, per silver ounce sold and per equivalent-silver ounce sold; attributable per-ounce equivalents = 100%-basis values (same unit cost). Equivalent-silver conversions used 2024 realized prices ($28.78/oz Ag, $2,430.76/oz Au, $0.92/lb Pb, $1.28/lb Zn). MAG equity-accounted its Juanicipio interest; consolidated FY2024 income from associate was the main earnings driver.

mines.processing: 4,000 tpd plant (operator Fresnillo): silver-lead and zinc concentrates plus pyrite/gravimetric concentrates; treated at Met-Mex, Torreón
mines.mine_notes: 44%-attributable: Ag production 8.184 Moz (100% basis 18.6 Moz); eq Ag production 11.792 Moz (100% basis 26.8 Moz); Ag sold 7.2996 Moz (100% basis 16.590 Moz); Au sold 14,568 oz (100% basis 33,110 oz); Pb sold 16,012,480 lbs (100% basis 36,392,000 lbs); Zn sold 24,467,960 lbs (100% basis 55,609,000 lbs). Head grade 468 g/t Ag / 712 g/t eq Ag; recovery 93%; ore processed 1,328,178 t (100% basis). Cash cost $0.88/oz Ag sold (100% basis; $8.67/oz eq Ag sold). AISC $5.54/oz Ag sold (100% basis; $12.03/oz eq Ag sold). Fresnillo Silver Trend, Zacatecas State, Mexico.
100% earn-in exploration project in Utah, USA. Multi-phase drilling program; no production, no reserves.
100% owned exploration project in the Abitibi region (Kirkland Lake area), Ontario, Canada. 41,447 m drilled in 2024; no production, no reserves.
